item.title: CEO Robby Yung on how AI reboots The Sandbox
item.summary: After some difficult years, The Sandbox is growing in confidence in 2026 as it reorganizes its vision around AI in the shape of its new AI-centric Sandbox Studio tools. Speaking on the Blockchain Gaming World podcast, CEO Robby Yung says the company has spent almost three years developing Sandbox Studio.
